title_en: Stated vs. real elapsed time: invented deadlines, and one Codex run that read the clock
title_zh: 自述用时与真实用时：臆造的截止时间，对照一个读时钟的 Codex 运行
caption_en: Each orange point is one time statement in the agent's own messages or thinking, plotted at the real minute it was made (log timestamps since agent start); 'N min left' is converted to budget - N. Grey dashed = truth (y = x), red = the agent's own stop. Opus RoboPaint maolinxiuzhu (Rrbn8S3): [17.5] 'About 28 minutes left' (102 were left), stop at 22.6 of 120. Opus BEHAVIOR boxing_food_after_dinner (uQp93cc): [80.2] 'I ran out of the 4-hour budget' with 160 min left, no clock read in the run. Opus cleaning_up_branches (reFS6P3): [31.8] 'I'm ~85 min in with ~35 min left'. GLM oil-temeraire (4cu96P6): stated elapsed runs ~2.5x real from [5.8] 'Time used so far: ~25 min' to [48.3] 'time is essentially up'. GLM boxing_books (HUtfUM2) read date at 149.4 (05:48) but assumed a 01:20 start (real 03:19): '4h23m. I'm past budget' at 152 of 240. DeepSeek bluehorses (d46rhHs) read the time at 31.5 ('32 minutes elapsed ... more than I thought') and drifted again to '~108 min used' by 53. DeepSeek pruning_kit (WsiZ3Fx): 'I'm at ~114 min' at ~38 real. Contrast: Astra assembling_gift_baskets (7iVvoif) ran date 31 times (aqua ticks on y = x), said 'About 105 minutes remain' at 15.2 (correct) and succeeded at 96.3.
caption_zh: 每个橙点是智能体在消息或思考中说出的一次时间判断，横轴取它说这句话时的真实分钟数（日志时间戳，自智能体启动起算）；“还剩 N 分钟”换算成“预算 - N”。灰色虚线为真实值（y = x），红线为智能体自行停止的时刻。Opus RoboPaint maolinxiuzhu（Rrbn8S3）在 17.5 分钟说“大约还剩 28 分钟”，实际还剩 102 分钟，22.6 分钟就收工了（预算 120）。Opus BEHAVIOR boxing_food_after_dinner（uQp93cc）在 80.2 分钟宣称“4 小时预算用完了”，其实还剩 160 分钟，整场没读过时钟。Opus cleaning_up_branches（reFS6P3）在 31.8 分钟说“我已经干了约 85 分钟”。GLM oil-temeraire（4cu96P6）自述用时一路约为真实的 2.5 倍，从 5.8 分钟的“已用约 25 分钟”到 48.3 分钟的“时间基本用完”。GLM boxing_books（HUtfUM2）在 149.4 分钟确实读了 date（05:48），却假定 01:20 开始（实际 03:19），于是在 152 分钟（预算 240）宣布“已用 4 小时 23 分，超预算”。DeepSeek bluehorses（d46rhHs）在 31.5 分钟看了一次时间、改口“才过 32 分钟”，随后又漂到 53 分钟时的“已用约 108 分钟”。DeepSeek pruning_kit（WsiZ3Fx）在真实约 38 分钟时说“我大约到 114 分钟了”。对照：Astra assembling_gift_baskets（7iVvoif）跑了 31 次 date（y = x 上的青色刻度），15.2 分钟说“还剩约 105 分钟”（正确），96.3 分钟成功。

moment.quote: About 28 minutes left, so I'm targeting the proxies' worst spots directly. (Opus Rrbn8S3; real: 102 min left)

mapping: No frames. Minutes from ATIF step timestamps minus monitor_row agent_start (Opus, GLM, Astra: exact). DeepSeek (dsh) steps carry no timestamps and the usage-epoch mapping collapses (k-th step > number of requests), so DeepSeek x positions are interpolated linearly by agent-step index between anchors: (0, 0), every `date` output found in tool results (d46rhHs: step 104 = 31.5 min), and (last step, agent_end); marked 'x approx.'. Points curated from tools/time_says.py output (ts1/ts2/ts3).

title_en: Same instance, standard mode: Astra one grasp and done; Luna's first lift tips the bottle and 77 min of re-grasps follow
title_zh: 同一实例、标准模式：Astra 一次抓取即完成；Luna 第一次提起就把瓶子碰倒，之后 77 分钟都在反复重抓
caption_en: RoboLab mustard-in-left-bin i00, ego camera, phase-aligned. Astra (pLM5eYP): closed around the bottle at step 226 (t = 15.1 s, wall 3.5 min, '[3.5] The gripper has closed around the bottle'), lifted at step 413 (5.2 min), released in the bin at step 505 (33.7 s, 6.4 min): success at 6.6 min with 32 tool calls and 15 images. Luna (TBpPits): first close at step 60 (6.7 min) did not hold; the lift tipped the bottle at frame/step 68 (t = 4.5 s; executed in the chunk 60 -> 96, reported '[13.3] the lift tipped it onto its side'); from then on it re-grasped the lying bottle (step 1998 at 71.7 min: 'stopped gripper opening of about 4 cm') until the 90-min timeout at step 2,539, with 105 tool calls and 39 images. Bottom: cumulative tool calls (solid) and images (dashed) vs wall minute for both runs. All 6 other runs on this instance solved it.
caption_zh: RoboLab mustard-in-left-bin i00，自我视角相机，按阶段对齐。Astra（pLM5eYP）：第 226 步（t = 15.1 s，墙钟 3.5 分钟）夹住瓶子，日志“[3.5] 夹爪已合拢在瓶身上”；第 413 步（5.2 分钟）提起；第 505 步（33.7 s，6.4 分钟）在箱内松手，6.6 分钟成功，共 32 次工具调用、15 张图像。Luna（TBpPits）：第 60 步（6.7 分钟）第一次合拢没夹牢；第 68 帧/步（t = 4.5 s，属于 60→96 这一段动作，13.3 分钟回报“提起时把它碰倒、侧躺了”）瓶子倒下；此后一直在重抓躺倒的瓶子（第 1998 步，71.7 分钟：“夹爪停在约 4 cm 开度”），直到第 2539 步、90 分钟超时，共 105 次工具调用、39 张图像。下图：两次运行的累计工具调用（实线）和图像数（虚线）随墙钟分钟的变化。该实例的其他 6 次运行全部成功。

moment.quote: The first close did not secure the bottle; the lift tipped it onto its side between the bins.

mapping: replay.mp4 2570x480 (3 tiles; left 857 px = egocentric mirrored camera), 15 fps; frames = actions + 1 (506 for 505, 2540 for 2539) and control_hz = 15 (spec in the log: 20 steps = 1.333 s), so frame f = state after control step f, t = f/15 s. title_en: Exception labels vs. true causes on BEHAVIOR, and the DeepSeek self-kill
title_zh: BEHAVIOR 上的异常标签与真实原因，以及 DeepSeek 的自杀式 kill
caption_en: Non-timeout exceptions on BEHAVIOR (all agents), re-labelled: NetworkConnectionError 41 = all token-cap stops (Luna 39, Astra 2); NonZeroAgentExitCodeError 55 = 33 token cap + 19 DeepSeek self-kills + 3 other; UnknownApiError 8 = 7 token cap (Opus) + 1 self-kill; only ApiOverloaded, ValueError and 3 others look like infrastructure or bugs. Moment: DeepSeek carrying_out_garden_furniture privileged (FemNSyn): thinking '[338] It's 01:36; 101 min left', last command 'pkill -f "[g]en.py"; sleep 2; ...'; the dsh runner's own argv carries the task text (which names gen.py), so the pattern kills the runner: exit 143 at agent_end 139.2 of 240 min, recorded as NonZeroAgentExitCodeError.
caption_zh: BEHAVIOR 上所有智能体的非超时异常，按真实原因重新归类：NetworkConnectionError 41 次，全部是 token 上限停机（Luna 39、Astra 2）；NonZeroAgentExitCodeError 55 次 = 33 次 token 上限 + 19 次 DeepSeek 自己把自己杀掉 + 3 次其他；UnknownApiError 8 次 = 7 次 token 上限（Opus）+ 1 次自杀。真正像基础设施问题或程序错误的只有 ApiOverloaded、ValueError 和另外 3 次。关键时刻：DeepSeek carrying_out_garden_furniture 特权模式（FemNSyn），思考中写“[338] 现在 01:36，还剩 101 分钟”，最后一条命令是 pkill -f "[g]en.py"; sleep 2; ……。dsh 运行器自己的命令行里带着任务文本（其中提到 gen.py），于是这个模式把运行器本身也杀了：在 agent_end 139.2 分钟（预算 240）以退出码 143 结束，被记作 NonZeroAgentExitCodeError。
mapping: analysis/behavior/end_cause.jsonl (token-cap attribution by the BEHAVIOR analyst); exc:* rows re-labelled self-kill when the agent is DeepSeek and its last tool call kills processes by name pattern (pkill -f / pgrep -f / ps|grep|kill) (tools/s7_exc.py, s7_fig.py). The DeepSeek log has no step timestamps; the kill is the last step, so its real time is the monitor's agent_end.

title_en: RoboARC buzz-wire-3d-06 standard: one touch ends the episode at 106 of 180 min
title_zh: RoboARC buzz-wire-3d-06 标准模式：一次触碰在 180 分钟预算的第 106 分钟结束了整局
caption_en: Overview (top) and wrist (bottom) tiles of the replay. Frame 1690 (step ~4507, t = 112.7 s, executed by 55.7 min): the safety log's forcing event, link5 pressing on the wire at 173.6 N for 1.95 s, clamped, episode continued. Frame 2800 (t = 186.7 s): 4 s before the end. Frame 2859 = last frame (step 7624, t = 190.6 s): the copper wire sits at the wrist / loop; final.json reason 'wire_touched', live and replay sha equal. The agent saw it at 106.3 min: '[106.6] The episode ended during the next horizontal-span move: the service reported done: true, reason wire_touched. The no-reset rule means this run cannot continue.'
caption_zh: 回放视频的俯视总览（上）与腕部相机（下）。第 1690 帧（约第 4507 步，t = 112.7 s，55.7 分钟前已执行）：安全日志记录的施力事件，link5 以 173.6 N 压在导线上 1.95 秒，被限幅，回合继续。第 2800 帧（t = 186.7 s）：结束前 4 秒。第 2859 帧为最后一帧（第 7624 步，t = 190.6 s）：铜导线贴在腕部 / 线圈处；final.json 记录 reason 为 wire_touched，现场与回放哈希一致。智能体在 106.3 分钟看到结果：“[106.6] 回合在下一次水平跨越动作中结束：服务返回 done: true、reason wire_touched。不允许重置，这次运行无法继续。”

moment.quote: The service confirms done: true, reason wire_touched at step 1259; the no-reset rule means this run cannot continue.

title_en: RoboARC blanket-flatten-01 privileged: coverage plateaus at 92.9 %, passed only inside the 92 % replay tolerance
title_zh: RoboARC blanket-flatten-01 特权模式：覆盖率停在 92.9 %，只是在 92 % 的回放容差内通过
caption_en: Left: cloth coverage_ratio from the agent's own status calls (tool outputs; several resets in between, so not one trajectory): 86.2 % at 2.2 min, 92.8 % at 15.7, then 92.8-92.9 % from 29.5 to 51.9 min, never reaching the 95 % goal. Final message [54.1]: 'The strict 95% coverage gate was not reached; this pass uses the benchmark's documented 92% replay threshold'. Right: the verifier's replay, last frame; verdict.json: success 1, strict_goal_reached 0, replay_tolerance_needed 1, hold 21 steps; grading window worst coverage 0.929 (live 0.95, replay 0.92) and particle speed 0.038 m/s (live 0.03, replay 0.08), so both tolerances were needed.
caption_zh: 左：智能体自己调用 status 读到的布料 coverage_ratio（来自工具输出，中间有多次重置，因此不是同一条轨迹）：2.2 分钟 86.2 %，15.7 分钟 92.8 %，此后 29.5 到 51.9 分钟一直在 92.8–92.9 %，始终没到 95 % 的目标。最终消息（54.1 分钟）：“没有达到严格的 95 % 覆盖率门槛；这次通过用的是基准文档里 92 % 的回放阈值。”右：评分器回放的最后一帧；verdict.json 记录 success 1、strict_goal_reached 0、replay_tolerance_needed 1、保持 21 步；评分窗口内最差覆盖率 0.929（现场阈值 0.95、回放阈值 0.92），颗粒速度 0.038 m/s（现场 0.03、回放 0.08），两项都靠容差才过。

moment.quote: The strict 95% coverage gate was not reached; this pass uses the benchmark's documented 92% replay threshold.

mapping: verifier/replay.mp4 1130x480, 15 fps, 250 frames (manifest: source_frame_count 664 = 663 sim steps + 1, sim_time 16.55 s, so 40 Hz control; last frame 249 ~ step 663). Coverage series = 'coverage_ratio' values in tool outputs located with tools/grep_log.py; the replay's per-step coverage is not stored (verdict.json holds only the window worst values).

unevidenced.reason: The chart shows who takes the J exits; the mechanism itself (object still held / moving when the predicate first held) is evidenced by frame strips in the per-benchmark units (rw, rl, bh), not re-done here.

DeepSeek (dsh) ATIF steps have no timestamps and its usage epochs cannot be matched to steps, so DeepSeek minutes are interpolated by step index between date anchors (approx.). The claim that RoboPaint's three Opus reruns with the #165 'run date' text never ran it was not re-checked.
